principle: First impressions are best when a page is both visually simple and looks like what people expect from its category.
detect: Dense pages with many colours and shapes, or layouts that do not resemble a typical landing page of their kind.
fix: Reduce visual complexity first, then keep the familiar structure (nav, hero, proof) while refining the details.

source.title: The role of visual complexity and prototypicality regarding first impression of websites
source.author: Tuch, Presslaber, Stöcklin, Opwis & Bargas-Avila (2012)
